Prisma organic growth material

Gray-Scott finite-difference update adapted from:
https://github.com/dueyama/gray-scott-3d
Copyright (c) 2026 Daishin Ueyama. MIT License (see LICENSE).
Inspected source: js/workers/simWorker.js, October 2026.

Prisma additions: seeded distributed nuclei, packed concentration/gradients,
periodic object-space texture, bounded worker cache, material shading and UI.
No TouchDesigner plugin or commercial project is bundled.

Background on the model and parameter behavior:
https://www.karlsims.com/rd.html
